empty: No priced call in this session yet.
unavailable: The cost ledger is not reachable from this session.
money.mixed: this session mixes {currencies}; totals are not summed
column.scope.title: A turn row holds the turn total; click a row to expand or collapse its steps
column.model.title: the provider and model that priced this call, with the pricing mode, region and tier the ledger recorded
column.files.title: the files this call touched, each pill dot carrying its stage tone; a call that touched no file shows its token count
column.tokens.title: input + cache read + cache write + output tokens of the call
column.cache.title: cache read / (input + cache read + cache write): the share of the prompt the cache served
column.cacheRead.title: the money the cache-read tokens cost; the light bar segment
column.input.title: the money the uncached input tokens cost; the primary bar segment
column.output.title: the money the output tokens cost; the warm bar segment
column.other.title: the total minus cache read, input and output: cache writes, reasoning and any remainder; the neutral bar segment
column.allocation.title: the direct cost the touched bytes paid, then the amortized context cost spread over the call's files
column.total.title: the total cost split: light cache read, blue input, orange output, gray cache write and reasoning. Bar length uses a square-root scale; steps compare only with the steps of the same turn, turns with turns
turn.label: Turn {turn}
turn.toggle.title: Expand or collapse the steps of this turn
step.label: Step {step}
step.toggle.aria: Expand or collapse the file details of step {step}
step.started.title: Step started at {time}
detail.title: Click this row to expand or collapse the file details
state.unpriced.title: the ledger recorded no price row for this call, so its money is whatever the ledger stored
state.failed.title: the call recorded error code {code}
state.attempts.title: {count} attempts ran before the settled message
state.cacheMiss.title: the cache served less than half of the prompt tokens
files.title: {calls} calls: {files}
files.saving.title: the cache saving against the uncached input rate
totals.session.title: every call this session recorded in the ledger, not only the rows loaded here
topFiles.label: Top files
topFiles.title: the files with the largest allocated cost in this session
topFiles.empty: No file carries an allocated cost yet.
